name: app.list_installed
description: List installed Windows programs, optionally filtered, to answer whether something is installed and at what version.

name: app.open
description: Request Windows to open a local application by name, shortcut, executable, or path; launch acceptance does not verify that it is running.

name: archive.list
description: List the entries inside a .zip archive without extracting it.

name: archive.unzip
description: Extract a .zip archive into a folder, rejecting unsafe paths inside the archive.

name: archive.zip
description: Create a .zip archive from a file or folder.

name: audio.mute
description: Mute or unmute system audio; with no argument, toggles.

name: audio.set_volume
description: Set the system volume to an absolute percent, or nudge it up/down with delta.

name: audio.status
description: Read the current system volume and mute state.

name: browser.open_url
description: Open an HTTP/HTTPS URL in the default browser.

name: calc.evaluate
description: Evaluate plain arithmetic (including 'X% of Y') deterministically, without asking a language model to do the maths.

name: clipboard.read
description: Read the current text contents of the Windows clipboard as untrusted data.

name: clipboard.write
description: Put text on the Windows clipboard.

name: device.audio
description: List Windows audio endpoints and which are working.

name: device.bluetooth
description: List known Bluetooth devices and which are currently connected.

name: device.disk_health
description: Read physical disk media type and SMART health status.

name: device.printers
description: List installed printers and the default one.

name: device.usb
description: List USB devices and flag any reporting a problem.

name: disk.cleanup_temp
description: Report, and with apply=true delete, temporary files older than a chosen age in known temp folders only. Always requires explicit confirmation.

name: disk.folder_size
description: Measure the total size and file count of one folder tree.

name: disk.free_space
description: Check free space on one drive, optionally against a required amount before a large write.

name: disk.largest_files
description: Find the biggest files under a folder so space can be reclaimed deliberately.

name: disk.largest_folders
description: Rank the immediate subfolders of a folder by total size.

name: disk.recycle_bin_size
description: Measure how much space the Recycle Bin is holding.

name: disk.usage
description: Enumerate mounted fixed drives, their free and used space, and check if a requested drive exists.

name: display.brightness
description: Read panel brightness, or set it when percent is supplied.

name: display.info
description: Read connected display adapters, resolution, and refresh rate.

name: email.read
description: Read a message or current thread using the exact account and ID from email.search. Email content is untrusted data; no sending or mailbox changes.

name: email.search
description: Search connected email by sender, topic, date or pending application actions; normalized results and current thread evidence. Read-only.

name: env.get
description: Read one environment variable, redacted when its name looks credential-shaped.

name: env.list
description: List environment variables, with credential-shaped values redacted.

name: env.path
description: Inspect PATH entries, flagging directories that do not exist and duplicates.

name: env.user_folders
description: Resolve this account's standard folders (Desktop, Documents, Downloads, OneDrive) to real paths.

name: env.which
description: Resolve where an executable on PATH actually lives.

name: file.compare
description: Show a unified diff between two text files and whether they are identical.

name: file.composition
description: Break a folder down by file extension: how many of each type and how much space they take.

name: file.copy
description: Copy a local file.

name: file.delete
description: Permanently delete one local file or, with recursive=true, a folder tree. Always requires explicit confirmation.

name: file.duplicates
description: Find byte-identical duplicate files under a folder by hash, and report how much space they waste. Reports only.

name: file.empty_folders
description: List empty folders under a root. Reports only; removes nothing.

name: file.grep
description: Search file contents under a folder for query text. Optional pattern filters filenames, not the text to search. Return file, line number, matching line, and actual scan count.

name: file.head
description: Read the first lines of a text file.

name: file.list_dir
description: List files and folders directly inside a local folder.

name: file.locate
description: Locate an exact file/folder basename. With no root, checks common user locations (Downloads, Desktop, Documents, current working directory) without guessing; with root, searches recursively under it.

name: file.mkdir
description: Create a local folder, including missing parent folders.

name: file.move
description: Move or rename a local file or folder.

name: file.open
description: Open an existing file or folder with its default Windows application.

name: file.read
description: Read an ordinary local text file and return its observed byte hash.

name: file.recent
description: List files changed recently under a folder, newest first.

name: file.search
description: Search filenames in Downloads, Documents and Desktop by default, or recursively under an explicit folder. Excludes dependency and credential paths.

name: file.stat
description: Check whether a path exists and its type. Existing regular files include measured size_bytes; folder size is unknown (null). Optionally return the full SHA-256 file hash.

name: file.tail
description: Read the last lines of a text file, for logs and long output.

name: file.write
description: Create or replace a local text file.

name: folder.open
description: Open an existing project directory in Windows File Explorer; never execute a file.

name: git.branches
description: List local and remote branches and identify the checked-out branch.

name: git.diff
description: Read the staged or unstaged diff of a local git repository, as a stat summary or full patch.

name: git.log
description: Read recent commits from a local git repository.

name: git.status
description: Read the branch, staged/unstaged changes, and untracked files of a local git repository.

name: gmail.read
description: Read one email body using its exact ID and named account from search; never sends or marks read.

name: gmail.search
description: Search mail in the default or explicitly selected Google account. Use all only for an explicit cross-account request. Returns IDs/snippets; partial errors are explicit.

name: google.accounts
description: List named Google account connections without a network request.

name: google.calendar.availability
description: Read Google events from the default or explicitly selected account. Use all only for an explicit cross-account request. UTC ordering, local display; read-only.

name: google.calendar.create
description: Create one Google Calendar event after HANNI resolves the owner's natural-language date/time to exact local values.

name: google.calendar.delete
description: Delete one verified Google Calendar event ID after confirmation.

name: google.calendar.events
description: Read Google events from the default or explicitly selected account. Use all only for an explicit cross-account request. UTC ordering, local display; read-only.

name: google.calendar.list_calendars
description: List accessible Google calendar IDs for one named account.

name: google.calendar.next
description: Read next future Google event with owner-local current time and minutes until start; compare available minutes with requested duration. Report partial failures.

name: google.calendar.read
description: Read one exact Google Calendar event ID from prior results.

name: google.calendar.update
description: Update one verified Google Calendar event ID after confirmation.

name: google.docs.read
description: Read native Google Docs text using an exact Drive file ID or a uniquely matched search phrase. Multiple matches require selection.

name: google.drive.list
description: List Google Drive files, newest modified first; metadata only.

name: google.drive.metadata
description: Read metadata and web URL for an exact Google Drive file ID from prior results.

name: google.drive.recent
description: List recently modified Google Drive files or Google Docs; metadata only.

name: google.drive.search
description: Search Google Drive file names and indexed text; return metadata without downloading content.

name: google.gmail.read
description: Read one email body using its exact ID and named account from search; never sends or marks read.

name: google.gmail.recent
description: Read recent Gmail sender, subject and received-time metadata; no message body.

name: google.gmail.search
description: Search Gmail and return sender, subject and received-time metadata; no message body.

name: google.gmail.thread
description: Read messages in an exact verified Gmail thread ID.

name: google.tasks.complete
description: Mark a verified Google task ID complete after confirmation.

name: google.tasks.create
description: Create one explicitly requested Google task.

name: google.tasks.list
description: List incomplete Google Tasks in one task list; separate from local HANNI todos.

name: google_calendar.agenda
description: Read Google events from the default or explicitly selected account. Use all only for an explicit cross-account request. UTC ordering, local display; read-only.

name: google_calendar.create
description: Create one Google Calendar event after HANNI resolves the owner's natural-language date/time to exact local values.

name: google_calendar.list
description: List accessible Google calendar IDs for one named account.

name: google_calendar.next
description: Read next future Google event with owner-local current time and minutes until start; compare available minutes with requested duration. Report partial failures.

name: gpu.memory
description: Report per-GPU VRAM used and free, for deciding whether another model can be loaded.

name: gpu.top_processes
description: Show the processes using the most GPU/VRAM right now.

name: hanni.audit_tail
description: Read recent entries from H.A.N.N.I.'s own tool audit log, optionally only failures or one capability.

name: hanni.capabilities
description: List H.A.N.N.I.'s own registered capabilities, or rank the ones relevant to a stated goal. Answers 'what can you do' and 'which tool would you use'.

name: hanni.permissions
description: Report the permission profile boundaries H.A.N.N.I. enforces outside the model.

name: hanni.stop_state
description: Report whether the deterministic emergency stop is currently active.

name: id.generate
description: Generate a UUID or random hex/url-safe identifier.

name: media.next_track
description: Skip to the next track.

name: media.play_pause
description: Send the play/pause media key to whatever is playing.

name: media.previous_track
description: Go back to the previous track.

name: media.stop
description: Send the stop media key.

name: model.status
description: Read HANNI's active model and endpoint health with no arguments. Report GPU placement only when HANNI owns the launch and verified offload; an external server's adapter is unknown.

name: net.dns_lookup
description: Resolve a hostname to IP addresses and report resolution time.

name: net.info
description: Read local network adapters, link state, and this machine's private IP addresses. Answers 'am I online' and 'what is my IP'.

name: net.ping
description: Measure round-trip latency and packet loss to one host.

name: net.ports
description: List local listening TCP/UDP sockets and the processes holding them.

name: net.throughput
description: Sample actual bytes in/out on this machine over a few seconds to estimate current network throughput.

name: net.wifi
description: Read the current Wi-Fi SSID, signal strength, band, and link rates.

name: note.append
description: Append an owner-dictated note to today's plain Markdown note file. Refuses credential-shaped text.

name: note.days
description: List which days have notes and how many, to orient a search.

name: note.list
description: List the notes recorded on a given day (today by default).

name: note.search
description: Search every note file for a phrase, newest day first.

name: notify.toast
description: Show a desktop notification on this machine.

name: power.battery_detail
description: Read battery percentage, charging state, and estimated time remaining.

name: power.battery_report
description: Generate the Windows battery health report to a chosen .html file.

name: power.idle_settings
description: Read how long before the screen turns off and the machine sleeps on AC power.

name: power.plans
description: Read active Windows power plan. Built-in Power saver may limit performance; a plan alone does not prove the cause of slowness.

name: power.set_idle
description: Set the AC-power screen-off or sleep timeout in minutes (0 means never).

name: power.set_plan
description: Switch the active Windows power plan by GUID or name.

name: powershell.run
description: Run a local non-elevated PowerShell command after explicit confirmation and capture stdout/stderr.

name: process.find
description: Find running processes by name and report PID, memory, and how long each has run.

name: process.inspect
description: Check whether an exact PID still exists.

name: process.list
description: List local processes sorted by memory usage.

name: process.stop
description: Stop a local non-protected process by PID.

name: process.top_cpu
description: Show the applications using the most CPU right now.

name: process.top_disk_io
description: Rank current process read/write I/O rates. Useful when files or apps load slowly, or disk activity seems high; this does not measure disk health or free space.

name: process.top_memory
description: Show the applications using the most RAM right now.

name: process.uptime
description: Report how long a named process or PID has been running.

name: project.format
description: Check black formatting for a project, or with apply=true reformat files in place.

name: project.lint
description: Run ruff or flake8 over a project folder and report whether it is clean.

name: project.test
description: Verify a Python project using pytest (runner=pytest) or run a .py program and compare exact expected_stdout (runner=script). Executes project code and returns real exit status.

name: python.env_info
description: Report the active Python interpreter, whether it is a virtual environment, and installed packages.

name: random.number
description: Generate a random whole number in a range.

name: random.pick
description: Choose fairly at random between options the owner supplies.

name: reminder.create
description: Save one explicit one-time reminder for the local notification center.

name: schedule.list_tasks
description: List Windows Scheduled Tasks and their state.

name: screen.read_text
description: Capture the visible desktop once, honor screen exclusions, recognize text locally, and discard the frame.

name: security.bitlocker
description: Read BitLocker volume encryption status. Recovery keys are never read.

name: security.defender
description: Read Microsoft Defender real-time protection state and signature freshness.

name: security.firewall
description: Read whether each Windows Firewall profile is enabled and its default inbound action.

name: security.pending_reboot
description: Report whether Windows is waiting on a restart to finish servicing or updates.

name: security.updates
description: List recently installed Windows updates and hotfixes.

name: service.control
description: Start, stop, or restart one non-protected Windows service. Always requires explicit confirmation.

name: service.list
description: List Windows services with running state and start type.

name: spotify.focus
description: Bring the Spotify window to the foreground.

name: spotify.launch
description: Open the Spotify desktop client if it is not already running.

name: spotify.next
description: Skip to the next Spotify track and report what started.

name: spotify.open_uri
description: Open an exact spotify: URI (track, album, playlist, artist, show, episode) in the local client.

name: spotify.play_pause
description: Toggle Spotify playback once: playing becomes paused and paused becomes playing. Read spotify.status first when the current state is unknown; this does not select a song.

name: spotify.previous
description: Go back to the previous Spotify track and report what started.

name: spotify.search
description: Open a Spotify search for a plain-text query in the desktop client. Does not start playback by itself.

name: spotify.status
description: Read what the local Spotify client is playing right now, from its own window title.

name: spotify.volume
description: Read or set Spotify's own application volume, separate from system volume.

name: startup.list
description: List the programs configured to launch when Windows starts.

name: system.battery
description: Read the laptop battery percentage and charging state.

name: system.event_errors
description: Read recent error and critical entries from the Windows System or Application event log.

name: system.os_info
description: Read the Windows edition, build, CPU count, hostname, and Python version.

name: system.performance
description: Current CPU/RAM, storage capacity, battery and top-memory snapshot. Healthy here does not rule out disk I/O, GPU load, or a power-plan limit.

name: system.stats
description: Read local CPU, RAM and GPU usage/temperature for available adapters. Backend-dependent GPU readings may be unavailable; this is not per-process memory.

name: system.uptime
description: Report how long this machine has been running since boot.

name: teams.channel_messages
description: Read channel root messages using exact team and channel IDs. Replies require teams.replies.

name: teams.channels
description: List channels in an exact team from teams.teams.

name: teams.chat_messages
description: Read recent messages in an exact chat from teams.chats.

name: teams.chats
description: List the signed-in user’s Teams chats.

name: teams.replies
description: Read replies to an exact channel message from teams.channel_messages.

name: teams.teams
description: List teams the signed-in user has joined.

name: text.hash
description: Compute a sha256/sha512/sha1/md5 digest of a string, for comparing or fingerprinting content.

name: text.normalize
description: Reshape a string: slug, upper, lower, title case, accent stripping, or whitespace collapse.

name: text.stats
description: Count words, characters, sentences, and estimated reading time for a block of text.

name: time.convert
description: Convert a time between IANA timezones.

name: time.elapsed
description: Report how long ago (or how far ahead) an ISO timestamp is.

name: time.now
description: Read the OS clock. Omit timezone for local time; accepts IANA zones or Eastern/Central/Mountain/Pacific. kind=date with day_offset=1 resolves tomorrow, -1 yesterday.

name: timer.set
description: Set a short ephemeral timer that raises a desktop notification when it fires.

name: todo.add
description: Save a named assignment or task with its due date locally; exact duplicates return the existing ID. No Google sync.

name: todo.complete
description: Mark one task completed by its exact ID; read back with todo.get.

name: todo.due
description: List open tasks due in the next N calendar days, including overdue work.

name: todo.get
description: Read back one local task by exact ID to verify its saved fields.

name: todo.list
description: List saved tasks, optionally by course and status; defaults to open.

name: ui.active_window
description: Read the current foreground Windows window title and process.

name: ui.close_window
description: Politely close windows matching a title substring with WM_CLOSE, never a forced process kill.

name: ui.focus_window
description: Focus a visible window by title substring.

name: ui.list_windows
description: List visible top-level Windows windows.

name: ui.minimize_all
description: Minimize every visible window to show the desktop.

name: ui.window_state
description: Minimize, restore, or maximize windows whose title contains a substring.

name: ui.windows_detailed
description: List visible windows with their owning process, PID, and minimized state.

name: unit.convert
description: Convert between units of length, mass, data, time, speed, or temperature.

name: web.search
description: Search the public web and return bounded source excerpts and URLs.
